review_type: AI source checking and correction verification
initial_review_method: Two Astra medium agents reviewed all 24 complete supplied abstracts and cards in three packets, recorded in reviews/pilot-01.json, reviews/pilot-02.json, and reviews/pilot-03.json. The same agent reviewed packets 01 and 03. This gate reviewer initially reviewed packet-02 and then verified every correction across all packets; it did not independently repeat the full semantic review of all unaffected cards.

corrections_verified.method: Read all three initial review files, all eight affected original abstracts, and each corrected field in the repacked 24-card packet. Verified source meaning as well as equality with the correction manifest. Initial error counts remain unchanged by these repairs.

records.reason: The corrected object is the time derivative of relative entropy; negative and positive terms, N times expected KSD squared, and regular initialization match S2.

The correction acknowledges S3's definition of near optimal through corresponding i.i.d. rates. Exact assumptions, constants, horizons, and the quantitative interpretation of double-exponential improvement are not supplied in the abstract.

Missing information is qualified as full schedules and empirical comparator identities; this no longer denies the stated late-stage communication pattern, final-step merge, or theoretical parallel-SGD comparator.

The ASRs are now attached to the two named CUAs, without treating 42.9% as a maximum over the evaluated set. Attempt Rate as high as 92.5% and end-to-end ASRs up to 50% preserve their distinct metrics and qualifiers. This resolves the initial material finding.
Only the complete evaluated set and detailed construction or splits remain unknown; this preserves the two named CUAs and the stated 864-example benchmark.
Typically nearly unbounded restores the source qualifier; the remaining listed evaluation challenges are supported by S2 and S3.
The gap now states only the poor understanding of data's influence on motion, directly supported by S1, without the unsupported relative-understanding comparison.
The narrowed locator points exactly to the remaining gap claim, rather than including S4's method mechanism.
Without assuming it is finite correctly removes a restriction without excluding finite sets, and preserves the compact basic semi-algebraic domain and comparison with many existing approaches.
Generation is correctly located in the encoder's representation space, without attributing representation generation to the encoder itself; conditioning the image generator is supported by S5.
Sequence lengths reaching approximately 50,000 preserves the extent qualifier across the mid- to long-range classification and regression collection, rather than assigning that length to all tasks.

full_run_scope: This pilot decision permits expansion only with the exact extraction configuration above and the existing pilot_gate.md full-run checks, targeted repairs, and additional 36-card audit. A change to model, effort, prompt, or schema is not covered by this decision.
limitations: This is AI source-faithfulness checking, not independent scientific validation, experiment verification, evidence of Oral-selection causes, or measurement of lesson effectiveness.
The conclusion concerns the reviewed pilot and its applied corrections. It does not establish the accuracy of future or unreviewed corpus cards.
Extraction provenance is copied from the cards. Orchestration and review usage are unknown here; no token or monetary usage is inferred.
